subject: Small-ticket vendor allowlist & PO policy decision for Sage Systems pilot
messages:
From: Emily Torres <emily@sagesys.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenside.io
Date: 2027-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on PO requirements for pilot

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was excited about Redwood's latency and routing controls. We're hoping to spin up a small pilot (6 weeks, $1.6k total) to integrate the embeddings flow. Curious whether Redwood can accept an invoice-only path for a pilot of this size without a PO. Our procurement team typically requires POs for >$5k, but they asked me to confirm your policy.

I attached our W9 and a short company terms summary for onboarding. Let me know what you need from our side to get started fast.

Best,
Emily Torres
Head of Partnerships, Sage Systems
Attachments: sagesys-w9.pdf, sagesys-terms-brief.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Torres <emily@sagesys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirements for pilot

Emily — great to meet you yesterday.

Short answer: we have a standard PO-required policy for onboarding vendors, but there's an established ad-hoc pathway for small pilots that can be handled as "invoice-only" provided approvals from Finance and Procurement. To move quickly, can you confirm:

- Legal name and billing address exactly as it should appear on the invoice
- Expected pilot start date and invoice cadence (one-time vs monthly)
- Whether the pilot requires a DPA or any contract redlines beyond the terms doc you sent

I'll loop in Marissa from Finance and Hannah from Procurement to coordinate an exception if possible. If we get approvals, we can provision a seat and production keys within 48 hours.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirements for pilot

Looping in Procurement formally. For our records:

- Standard threshold requiring PO is $5,000 per vendor per month.
- Exceptions can be granted for pilots under $2,000 by Finance + Procurement with an invoice-only risk acknowledgement.

Hannah — can you confirm the checklist we need from Sage (W9, remit details, primary contact, and basic SOC2 question set if available)? Also flag any known compliance issues.

If all boxes are green, I can approve a single invoice-only onboarding and mark the vendor as "pilot-allowlist" for 90 days.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Torres <emily@sagesys.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirements for pilot

Hi Emily — thanks for sending the attachments. A few quick asks to satisfy Procurement:

1) Can you confirm the exact remittance address and EIN for invoicing?
2) We typically request a short answer to: "Do you store any customer data on shared third-party systems?" for a pilot — one line is fine.
3) Please indicate whether Sage requires any SLAs or uptime guarantees for the pilot environment.

If you reply with that info and the W9/EIN match, I'll submit the exception request.

On process: I'll file an "Invoice-only pilot" exception with a 90-day allowlist and a single-invoice limit of $2,500. Anything beyond that will require a PO.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Torres <emily@sagesys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirements for pilot

Hi Hannah / Logan,

Thanks — answers below and happy to move forward.

- Billing / remittance: Sage Systems, LLC, 412 Oakridge Blvd, Suite 200, Seattle, WA 98101
- EIN: 91-2345678
- Data: Pilot will send only non-production, anonymized datasets (no customer PII). We host logs in our managed cloud environment but do not retain user-level data beyond 7 days for this pilot.
- SLAs: No formal uptime SLA required for the pilot; standard best-effort support is fine.

We appreciate the 90-day pilot allowlist and single-invoice cap. Please let us know if you require a short signed acknowledgement form; otherwise we can issue the invoice at pilot completion.

Best,
Emily
Attachments referenced: sagesys-w9.pdf, sagesys-terms-brief.pdf
